text: The app takes ages to open my longest conversation. Find out why.
Three measurements, then a check, then one ranked list. Here it is before anything runs.

input.goal: Find out why the app is slow to open a long conversation

content: Plan proposed; waiting for the user.

plan.title: Find out why the app is slow to open a long conversation

steps.title: Measure how long each part of opening a conversation takes
steps.summary: Three helpers each time one part of opening a long conversation.
items: Turning it into the list the screen draws

steps.title: Check the three timings against the code that does the work
steps.summary: One helper checks those timings against the code, to catch anything mistaken.
steps.task: Read the three timing reports. For each number, find the code it claims to time and say whether the number could be right. Report anything you cannot confirm.

steps.title: Write one ranked list of what to fix
steps.summary: One helper writes a single list, slowest thing first.
steps.task: Turn the checked timings into one ranked list: the slowest thing first, with one sentence each on what would make it faster.
